name: Ouro · LoopLM
tagline: Train across depths, then refine the exit gate.
description: Every recursion passes through the coda and language-model head. An exit distribution weights the depth-specific losses. A final stage freezes the backbone and trains only the gate; inference exits according to cumulative halting probability.
paperTitle: Scaling Latent Reasoning via Looped Language Models
mechanism: 3 prelude + 3 core blocks × up to 3 recursions; each recursion also executes 3 coda blocks and the head
Joint objective: exit-weighted cross entropy minus 0.1 × exit entropy
The final 1,024 updates train only the gate, continuing the same data stream and schedule
limitations: The reference path evaluates all recursions. The temporal definition of adjacent-depth gate supervision must be recorded with each implementation version.
